newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Emmis EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Emmis EPS cut.

text.p: -- Gruntl & Co analyst Rita Zanella Benson said Friday she cut her fiscal 1998 earnings estimate for Emmis Broadcasting Corp to $1.35 a share from $1.39 and introduced a fiscal 1999 estimate of $1.85.
-- She said earnings are hurt from the dilutive effect of the acquisition of three small radio stations in St. Louis.
-- She continues to rate the stock outperform with a price target of $45 a share.

-- On Thursday, Emmis reported earnings for the fourth quarter of $0.11 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.01. Gruntal said these results were above its estimate of $0.08 a share and the Street consensus.

-- "Unfortunately, the overall weak stock market and the recent decline in the radio sector dampened Emmis' positive earnings announcement, as the stock closed down 1-1/4 (to 37-1/4 on Thursday)," Benson said.
